name: Nitrous oxide
warning: Uses rhythmic pulsing/flicker. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: one soft pulse as the envelope starts; barely a breath.
Light: gentle 2.5 Hz throb in scale and brightness.
Common: full wah-wah — throb + phase-picked frame echo + warm dimming mid-envelope.
Strong: deep throb, strong flanging, scintilla bursts at envelope peaks.
Heavy: near-whiteout at LFO peaks (late whiteOut); the whole arc decays and restarts every ~25 s.
